Meeting Title: Engineering onboarding improvements
Meeting Date: 2026-11-02

Amara Okafor: Amara Okafor: Let's anchor the discussion on scope and expected outcome. What has actually changed since the last check-in?
Theo Bennett: Theo Bennett: The current picture is new hires can build the service, but access requests and local setup take inconsistent amounts of time. We have recent onboarding notes show setup ranging from half a day to three working days, and the signal I am watching is the target is a working local environment by the end of day one.
Ella Morgan: Ella Morgan: My concern is a checklist alone may hide delays caused by approvals outside the engineering team. If IT must confirm the expected turnaround for repository and test-environment access, what do we tell the people relying on this work?
Dylan Price: Dylan Price: We can separate self-service setup steps from access dependencies and assign an escalation contact. We should keep which setup steps can be automated without broadening default permissions visible until that check is complete.
Amara Okafor: Amara Okafor: For the record, pilot a day-one checklist and track access wait time separately from setup time. Theo Bennett will draft the onboarding guide and validate it with the next two new starters before the next onboarding date; which setup steps can be automated without broadening default permissions remains unresolved.
